gdp_yoy.source: MoSPI/PIB Press Note on Quarterly GDP Estimates Q1 FY2026-27 (released 31 Aug 2026): real GDP +7.8% YoY; Q4 FY26 was also 7.8% (released 5 Jun 2026), so flat QoQ

cpi.source: MoSPI CPI (base 2024=100) for August 2026, released 14 Sep 2026 (4.82% YoY, up from 4.45% in July); figure read via secondary aggregators, MoSPI site not reachable

gsec10y.source: 10Y benchmark G-sec yield 7.21% on 1 Oct 2026, up ~23 bps over the past month (two-year high); via Trading Economics/market data, CCIL/RBI not reachable

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo at 5.25% on 5 Aug 2026 (fourth straight hold, 6-0, neutral stance); markets debating a possible hike at the 5-7 Oct meeting. No easing cycle underway.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Aug 2026 resolution via press coverage (Forbes India, IndiaBonds, JM Financial)

gov_capex.note: Centre's capex up 30% YoY to Rs 4.51 trn in Apr-Jul FY27, i.e. 37% of the Rs 12.22 trn Budget target (CGA data).
gov_capex.source: CGA data as reported by Business Standard, 31 Aug 2026

rural_recovery.note: 2026 SW monsoon ended ~12.6% below LPA (759.4 mm vs 868.6 mm), weakest since 2015, El Nino-driven; southern and eastern regions worst hit; long dry spells threaten kharif yields; food inflation rising.
rural_recovery.source: IMD end-of-season monsoon data as reported 30 Sep 2026 (Business Standard, DSIJ, TechTimes)
